title: 20 t/h, across the border.
hero_lead: A fully automated poultry feed line for Albadar Feed — grinding, mixing, pelletizing, cooling, screening and packing — engineered in Lahore, installed and commissioned in Kabul.
body_paragraphs:
Albadar Feed needed a complete poultry feed plant delivered into Kabul — a project where every flange, cable and commissioning engineer had to cross a border on schedule. SEMZON delivered it as a single turnkey scope.

The line runs the full six-stage SEMZON flow: intake cleaning, SMSP grinding, SMHY batching and mixing with automatic liquid addition, SZLH conditioning and pelleting, SKLN counterflow cooling with crumbling and screening, and 25/50 kg packing — all under one PLC operator screen.

Fabrication and pre-assembly in Lahore compressed the on-site programme; SEMZON site teams erected, wired and commissioned to rated output, then trained Albadar's operators on the panel. Spares ship from the same works that cut the first steel.

title: Fertilizer-scale fabrication.
hero_lead: A BOP fertilizer plant for Auriga, Karachi — SEMZON's standing reference for fertilizer-scale process fabrication delivered turnkey.
body_paragraphs:
Auriga required a bone-based (BOP) fertilizer plant at process scale — grinding, granulation, drying and screening engineered to run as one continuous line rather than a set of separate machines.

SEMZON delivered the full process chain with materials handling and structures fabricated in-house, coordinating every transfer point, height and airflow before anything shipped.

The result anchors the SEMZON fertilizer reference list and underpins the SSP and BOP plant scopes offered today.

title: Waste into product.
hero_lead: A waste-management and composting installation at Quetta — turning municipal and farm organics into saleable compost.
body_paragraphs:
The Quetta Waste Management Company needed to convert mixed organic waste into a graded, saleable compost rather than a disposal burden.

SEMZON supplied the sorting, size-reduction, maturation-handling and final screening equipment that takes raw organics through to product grade, with contaminant removal at the front end.

It is the working reference for SEMZON's 50–100 t/d organic compost plant scope.

title: Pellet systems for Punjab.
hero_lead: A pellet line installation for Roshan Feeds — one of Gujranwala's established poultry feed producers — built and supported from the SEMZON works in Lahore.
body_paragraphs:
Roshan Feeds needed to move from mash to dense, durable pellets to serve a growing poultry market around Gujranwala. SEMZON delivered the pelleting heart of the line — conditioning, pressing and cooling — matched to the mill's existing grinding and batching.

The installation is built around the SZLH ring-die pellet mill with steam conditioning and SKLN counterflow cooling, so pellets leave hard, low-fines and within a few degrees of ambient, ready to bag.

Fabricated and trial-run in Lahore, then installed and commissioned on site — with dies, rollers and wear parts supported from the same works for the life of the plant.
